items.caption: A modern redraw of 肉 in the Shuowen Small Seal tradition. Its rounded enclosing outline and two curved inner strokes show the received seal-script form associated with the character’s pictographic depiction of meat.
items.alt: Black seal-script glyph with a rounded enclosing outline and two curved strokes inside.
items.selection_reason: The image provides a clear visual example of the Shuowen Small Seal form and complements the sourced explanation of 肉 as a meat pictograph. It is a modern redraw, not an ancient specimen.

limitations.text: This redraw does not identify a photographed source exemplar or date the model it represents. The available evidence places 肉 in oracle-bone, Chu manuscript, and Small Seal categories, but does not establish dates for individual forms or a detailed sequence of graphic changes.
